blurb: Stash 37.0 is the April 2025 release of Morgan Houppin's classical hand-crafted evaluation C UCI chess engine, tuned with its built-in Texel tuner and OpenBench SPRT testing. It pairs magic bitboards, ProbCut, singular extensions, improving-scaled fractional LMR and quadratic LMP, pawn and non-pawn correction histories, and continuation/capture histories with a comprehensive classical evaluator and WDL score normalization. Adapted to UCI over WASI on the poll helper.
fidelityNotes: Single-threaded plain wasm32-wasip1 build using the C poll helper (Threads fixed to 1); Hash capped for 32-bit memory.

features.label: Magic Bitboards
features.implementation: 64-bit magic bitboards (with generic fallback for WASI and optional BMI2 PEXT natively).

features.label: PVS & Aspiration Windows
features.implementation: Iterative deepening PVS with root aspiration windows and normalized WDL scoring.

features.label: Null Move Pruning
features.implementation: Dynamic null-move pruning from depth 3 with zugzwang verification search.

features.label: ProbCut
features.implementation: Reduced capture search with SEE filtering to prune clear beta cutoffs early.

features.label: Singular Extensions
features.implementation: Excluded-move search extending singular transposition-table moves.

features.label: Fractional LMR
features.implementation: Improving- and quiet-aware fixed-point reduction table adjusted by search heuristics and history.

features.label: Quadratic LMP & RFP
features.implementation: Improving-scaled quadratic late move pruning paired with reverse futility pruning up to depth 7 and razoring.

features.label: Continuation & Correction History
features.implementation: Quiet, countermove, and continuation histories paired with pawn and non-pawn static-eval correction histories.

features.label: Capture History
features.implementation: Capture history combined with SEE and staged move picking for tactical ordering.

features.label: King-Pawn Eval Cache
features.implementation: Dedicated king-pawn structure cache (`kp_eval`) alongside the main transposition table.

features.label: KPK Bitbase
features.implementation: Exact precomputed king-and-pawn versus king bitbase for pawn endgames.

features.label: King Safety
features.implementation: Attack-weighted king zone danger, safe/unsafe checks, and pawn shelter/storm.

features.label: Tapered Classical Eval
features.implementation: Texel-tuned middlegame/endgame evaluation with outposts, mobility, threats, space, passed pawns, and endgame scaling.
